sections.text:
Ability Power 150. Damages all enemies with time-elemental physical damage.
Added effect: Increases ATK/MATK of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds, boosts Unison gauge by 10 for all allies excluding yourself, and heals the HP of all allies for Ability Power 80.
Level bonus: Ability Power of this Ability's damage boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
